title: CBDC Ban Has a 2030 Expiration Date
script_summary:
**CBDC BAN HAS A 2030 EXPIRATION DATE**

The Senate just handed you a gift wrapped with a timer. Eighty-nine to ten vote banning CBDCs—sounds clean. Read the fine print: 2030 sunset clause. Washington's telling you exactly when the surveillance window reopens.

**Three pressure systems colliding right now:**

One—geopolitical shock just repriced Fed cuts from nine percent to thirty-five percent probability in three weeks. Tighter money, longer. Two—record corporate bond issuance coming in 2026.
